proof_body:
by
  intro f f1 f2 a b hab hf hf1
  have hba : b - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hab.ne'
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K * (b - a) ^ 2 / 2 = f b - f a - f1 a * (b - a) :=
    ⟨(f b - f a - f1 a * (b - a)) * 2 / (b - a) ^ 2, by field_simp⟩
  have hg : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => f y - f a - f1 a * (y - a) - K * (y - a) ^ 2 / 2) (f1 x - f1 a - K * (x - a)) x := by
    intro x
    have h1 := (hf x).sub_const (f a)
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y => f1 a * (y - a)) (f1 a) x := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).sub_const a).const_mul (f1 a)
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun y => K * (y - a) ^ 2 / 2) (K * (x - a)) x := by
      have h4 := (((hasDerivAt_id' x).sub_const a).pow 2).const_mul K |>.div_const 2
      exact h4.congr_deriv (by norm_num; ring)
    exact (h1.sub h2).sub h3
  obtain ⟨c1, hc1, e1⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_zero hab (fun x _ => (hg x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt) (by simp; linarith) (fun x _ => hg x)
  have hg2 : ∀ x, HasDerivAt (fun y => f1 y - f1 a - K * (y - a)) (f2 x - K) x := by
    intro x
    have h1 := (hf1 x).sub_const (f1 a)
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y => K * (y - a)) K x := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).sub_const a).const_mul K
    exact h1.sub h2
  obtain ⟨c, hc, e2⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_zero hc1.1 (fun x _ => (hg2 x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt) (by simp; linarith) (fun x _ => hg2 x)
  refine ⟨c, ⟨hc.1, hc.2.trans hc1.2⟩, ?_⟩
  have hKc : f2 c = K := by linarith
  rw [hKc]
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (f f1 f2 : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a < b → (∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f1 x) x) → (∀ x, HasDerivAt f1 (f2 x) x) → ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo a b, f b = f a + f1 a * (b - a) + f2 c * (b - a) ^ 2 / 2
